verdict.rationale: Databricks' Delta table history documentation says you can query a table at a specific point in time using time travel and roll back a table, which covers point-in-time queries and restoring corrupted tables. The evidence is a single first-party mention and never addresses recovering dropped tables. missing for 10: documented restore of dropped tables (undrop/recovery), in-depth time-travel syntax and retention docs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can time-travel — query data as of a past point and restore dropped or corrupted tables from history

citations.quote: Use history information to audit operations, roll back a table, or query a table at a specific point in time using time travel.
